hook.en: Slice a sunflower stem and the vascular bundles form a neat ring. Slice a maize stem and they are scattered like dots. On a hot afternoon, why do some grass leaves roll up?
hook.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿ ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳು ಉಂಗುರದಂತೆ, ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳಂತೆ ಚದುರಿವೆ. ಬಿಸಿಲಿನ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳು ಏಕೆ ಸುರುಳಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ?

objectives.en: Explain the role of bulliform cells

narration.en: Slice a sunflower stem and the vascular bundles form a neat ring. Slice a maize stem and they are scattered like dots. On a hot afternoon, why do some grass leaves roll up?
narration.kn: ಸೂರ್ಯಕಾಂತಿ ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳು ಉಂಗುರದಂತೆ, ಮೆಕ್ಕೆಜೋಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಚುಕ್ಕೆಗಳಂತೆ ಚದುರಿವೆ. ಬಿಸಿಲಿನ ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಎಲೆಗಳು ಏಕೆ ಸುರುಳಿಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ?

body.en: A young dicot stem has an epidermis with a cuticle, trichomes and a few stomata. The cortex has a collenchymatous hypodermis, parenchymatous cortical layers and an endodermis whose cells are rich in starch grains, so it is called the starch sheath. The pericycle forms semi-lunar patches of sclerenchyma above the phloem. The vascular bundles are arranged in a ring, which is characteristic of the dicot stem, and each is conjoint, open and endarch. Medullary rays lie between the bundles and a large pith occupies the centre.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿದಳ ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಅಧಶ್ಚರ್ಮ, ಪಿಷ್ಟ ಕವಚ ಎನ್ನುವ ಅಂತಶ್ಚರ್ಮ, ಅರ್ಧಚಂದ್ರಾಕಾರದ ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಪರಿಚಕ್ರ. ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳು ಉಂಗುರದಲ್ಲಿ; ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ, ತೆರೆದ, ಎಂಡಾರ್ಕ್.

points.en: Ring of conjoint, open, endarch bundles

narration.en: A young dicot stem has an epidermis with a cuticle, trichomes and a few stomata. The cortex has a collenchymatous hypodermis, parenchymatous cortical layers and an endodermis whose cells are rich in starch grains, so it is called the starch sheath. The pericycle forms semi-lunar patches of sclerenchyma above the phloem.
narration.kn: ದ್ವಿದಳ ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊಲೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಅಧಶ್ಚರ್ಮ, ಪಿಷ್ಟ ಕವಚ ಎನ್ನುವ ಅಂತಶ್ಚರ್ಮ, ಅರ್ಧಚಂದ್ರಾಕಾರದ ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಪರಿಚಕ್ರ. ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳು ಉಂಗುರದಲ್ಲಿ; ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ, ತೆರೆದ, ಎಂಡಾರ್ಕ್.

body.en: A monocot stem has a sclerenchymatous hypodermis and a large number of scattered vascular bundles, each surrounded by a sclerenchymatous bundle sheath, in a large parenchymatous ground tissue. The bundles are conjoint and closed; peripheral bundles are generally smaller than central ones. Phloem parenchyma is absent, and water-containing cavities are present within the bundles.
body.kn: ಏಕದಳ ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಅಧಶ್ಚರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಚದುರಿದ ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳು; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಕವಚ. ಪುಂಜಗಳು ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದವು; ಅನ್ನನಾಳ ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಇಲ್ಲ.

narration.en: A monocot stem has a sclerenchymatous hypodermis and a large number of scattered vascular bundles, each surrounded by a sclerenchymatous bundle sheath, in a large parenchymatous ground tissue. The bundles are conjoint and closed; peripheral bundles are generally smaller than central ones. Phloem parenchyma is absent, and water-containing cavities are present within the bundles.
narration.kn: ಏಕದಳ ಕಾಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಅಧಶ್ಚರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಚದುರಿದ ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳು; ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಂದಕ್ಕೂ ಸ್ಕ್ಲೀರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಕವಚ. ಪುಂಜಗಳು ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಮತ್ತು ಮುಚ್ಚಿದವು; ಅನ್ನನಾಳ ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ ಇಲ್ಲ.

body.en: A dicot leaf is dorsiventral. Its lower (abaxial) epidermis generally has more stomata than the upper (adaxial) one. The mesophyll is differentiated into elongated, vertically arranged palisade parenchyma on the upper side and loosely arranged spongy parenchyma below. A monocot leaf is isobilateral: stomata are on both surfaces and the mesophyll is not differentiated into palisade and spongy layers. In grasses, large, empty, colourless bulliform cells on the upper epidermis lose water under stress, so the leaf curls inwards and reduces water loss.
body.kn: ದ್ವಿದಳ ಎಲೆ ಪೃಷ್ಠಾಧರ (ಡಾರ್ಸಿವೆಂಟ್ರಲ್): ಕೆಳಮೇಲ್ಮೈಯಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಪತ್ರರಂಧ್ರ, ಪ್ಯಾಲಿಸೇಡ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸ್ಪಂಜಿನಂತಹ ಪ್ಯಾರೆಂಕೈಮಾ. ಏಕದಳ ಎಲೆ ಸಮದ್ವಿಪಾರ್ಶ್ವ; ಹುಲ್ಲಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬುಲಿಫಾರ್ಮ್ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಎಲೆ ಸುರುಳಿ ಮಾಡಿ ನೀರಿನ ನಷ್ಟ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತವೆ.

points.en: Dorsiventral: palisade + spongy; more stomata below
Isobilateral: stomata on both surfaces; mesophyll undifferentiated
Bulliform cells: leaf rolling in grasses

problem.en: A stem section shows scattered vascular bundles, each with a sclerenchymatous sheath, no cambium and water-filled cavities. Identify the stem and describe its bundles in three words.

steps.en: Scattered bundles with a sclerenchymatous sheath are typical of a monocot stem.
No cambium means the bundles are closed.
Xylem and phloem lie on the same radius, so they are conjoint; water cavities confirm a monocot.

answer.en: Monocot stem; bundles conjoint, closed, scattered

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A stem section shows scattered vascular bundles, each with a sclerenchymatous sheath, no cambium and water-filled cavities. Identify the stem and describe its bundles in three words.

body.en: Dicot stem: Ring, Open, Endarch. Monocot stem: Scattered, Closed, Sheathed.

narration.en: Stem bundles in one line. Dicot stem: Ring, Open, Endarch. Monocot stem: Scattered, Closed, Sheathed.
